connectors.name: I2C connector (rear view, left of USB-C)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; pin positions from the board silkscreen (GND 3V3 SDA SCL left to right). USB-C is to the right, so position 1 is the right end.

connectors.name: UART connector (rear view, right of USB-C)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; pin positions from the board silkscreen (GND 3V3 TXD RXD left to right). USB-C is to the left, so position 1 is the left end.

connectors.name: SPK speaker connector (rear view, left edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; vertical connector, USB-C is at the bottom edge, so the bottom (-) end is position 1.

connectors.name: BAT battery connector (rear view, left edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; vertical connector, USB-C is at the bottom edge, so the bottom (-) end is position 1.

connectors.name: SWD / PC6 / GND pads (rear view, right edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; vertical pad row, USB-C is at the bottom edge, so the bottom (GND) pad is position 1.

connectors.name: GND / RST pads (front view, bottom edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal pad pair centred above the USB-C so neither end is clearly closer; top/left rule used (left first).

uncertain: SPK and BAT 2-pin connectors: the + and - marks beside them are taken as per-pin labels, and the 'BAT' text below the lower connector is taken to name that connector; the image does not draw explicit leaders.
SWD/PC6/GND and GND/RST: labeled round pads/holes, recorded as wiring points; the image does not show whether they are intended as header positions or test pads.
notes: One image with a front view (board silkscreen 'ESP32-S3-CAM-OVxxxx') and a rear view. Labels for the I2C/UART connectors use the GPIO names from the callout tables (rule 5), with the small board silkscreen (SDA, SCL, TXD, RXD; low resolution) first in functions, then the table's bus names. Skipped: TF card, camera FPC and SPI/QSPI LCD FPC tables (function lists without pin positions), ES7210+ES8311 codec table (internal GPIO assignments, no connector), USB-C, BOOT/USER/PWR buttons, CHG LED, MIC1/MIC2.
